guide.title: Ask my agent

questions.a: He learns how your people actually work, then builds AI and automation around the apps they already use. It saves time, raises quality, and he teaches the team to run it.
A personal assistant for every employee, built around their apps. Tickets get fixed by an agent right on the computer; hard ones go up to a person. Windows pilot, live checks pending.
Anything digital a team wants automated: quoting, dispatch, ordering, scheduling, paperwork. Built around their apps, with human sign-off and undo.
Not yet as a paid rollout. He has worked moving, plaster and shop jobs firsthand, and built 5 systems with 3,300+ passing checks.
A private research project that tests trading ideas on past market data. No real money, and no performance claims.

questions.q: What if a tool makes a mistake?
questions.a: People approve before anything goes out, every connection has an undo step, and files stay on the company's own computers.
Email is fastest, or grab the résumé.
